lines: FERRY TO CORVANE
No crossings while the lake is restless.
FERRY TO CORVANE
Crossings resume. Ferryman: Aldo.
The fish stopped jumping the night the Rift opened.
Even the reeds sound quieter. That's the Hush, they say.
Something glints on the reed islet west of the pier. Too far to wade, though.
Say, have you seen a Kelpup? The pups used to bark at my boat. Bring one by, would you?
That Kelpup of yours barked at my boat. Just like old times.
Tangled in the reeds: a Waking Moss!
Only reeds now, rustling in the wind.

child: My Puddlet won't answer when I call it anymore.
Grandpa Aldo says a Wayfarer with a strong bond can wake it up again.

lines: Crier: Hear ye! Veydal keeps its festivals, storm or no storm.
Wynn: Every week the lake throws up three new echoes. Same ones for every Wayfarer in Veydal.
Wynn: Beat all three and I'll pay out. Once a week, mind.
Ines: The lighthouse keeps old Rift echoes. I can wake them for you.
Ines: Five Wayfarers' echoes in a row, no rest in between. They grow with you.
Kestra: Two Rifts mended. The valley is calmer... and smaller.
Kestra: There's a third one, up north past the crest. Bigger than both.
Kestra: I still think something lives on the other side. When the ferry runs again, we find out together.
Kestra: So? Do we cross together?
Kestra: When Aldo opens the ferry, I'll be on it. Save me a seat.
Kestra: Going alone, then. I'll see you on the other side anyway.
Aldo waits by the boat, his old oar across his knees.
Aldo: Hold on tight. The lake still has opinions.
Aldo stops rowing and rubs his shoulder.

ferry_row_self: You take the oar. It's heavier than it looks.
Aldo: Ha! Mirela rowed like that. All arms, no rhythm. Keep going.
ferry_row_aldo: Aldo: Forty years since I rowed this far. Give an old man a minute.
He rows on, slow and steady, humming the lighthouse tune.
kestra_dock_together: Kestra: Good. Two cartographers see twice as much.
Kestra: I'll go ahead to Corvane once the ferry runs. Find me in Madderby.
kestra_dock_alone: Kestra: Hm. Your call. Mirela went alone too, you know.
Kestra: I'll still be in Corvane. Someone has to map what you mend.
